subject.title: fix: render workspace avatars in identity card

question: After the mechanical CI blockers are fixed, should this PR be the canonical avatar-401 fix and accept the stricter image-only local avatar projection policy?
rationale: Automation can remove unused imports and fix the test mock type, but it cannot choose the user-compatibility policy or decide which overlapping avatar PR should be the landing vehicle.
